gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-thai: Bold and modern, New Title links its tall lowercase together like a fine chain. Noto Serif Thai follows with a bookish, authoritative texture, its mellow stroke weights making a longer passage move along steadily.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Modern in attitude, New Title packs tall lowercase letters into tight, chain-like links. Noto Serif Tibetan brings a literary authority, its x-height rising close to cap height with a thickness shift you feel more than see.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-todhri: Traditional weight meets a modern edge here: New Title locks its tall lowercase into a fine chain up top. Noto Serif Todhri sits beneath it as a classic serif, thin curves still carrying real weight and a sizable x-height keeping the text readable on screen.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-toto: New Title links its tall lowercase like a fine chain. Noto Serif Toto is a dignified text serif with a hulking, chalky lowercase, and a longer passage reads with a brushed, slightly pressured weight that never turns fussy.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-vithkuqi: Noto Serif Vithkuqi reads round and friendly, with big lowercase bowls and stems a touch heavier than the crossbars. New Title sits above it bold and chain-linked, so a larger heading over modest body text would suit it nicely.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-yezidi: Noto Serif Yezidi reads as solid word blocks, not jagged skylines. New Title adds a bold, modern top line with tall lowercase, so a generous heading size above modest body text would let the contrast show.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-pt-serif-caption: Literary and editorial, PT Serif Caption stands out for a tall x-height you notice at a glance. New Title goes bolder above it, its tall lowercase linked like a fine chain, and the slight stroke modulation below keeps things steady.
gen-fs-new-title-lora: Lora brings a literary, bookish feel, with modest hairline thinning at the curves and a broad, welcoming c opening. Under New Title's chain-like, tall lowercase it reads more gently, in a moderate lowercase height.
gen-fs-oswald-crimson-pro: Crimson Pro is a refined text serif whose close-packed letters carry a subtle thick and thin cadence, with open c, e and s shapes. Oswald earns its keep as a big, short heading.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-recia: Tightly knit rows of text give Oswald a confident, strong look that stands out at once at the top of the page. Recia, a classic serif with light modulation and generous openings, takes over below with sharp authority.
